strengths: Comprehensive CI/CD pipeline with 4 parallel jobs (backend-tests, web-build, e2e, security-scan)
965 backend tests with pytest (28 test files)
E2E testing with Playwright (10 test specs across 2 browsers)
Mobile testing with Jest/React Native Testing Library (3 test files)
Helm chart with Argo Rollouts for canary deployments
Terraform for 3 cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) with full module structure
Security scanning (bandit, pip-audit, gitleaks) in CI
Docker multi-stage builds with SBOM generation
critical_gaps: No chaos engineering (Litmus, Chaos Mesh, Gremlin)
No semantic versioning automation (Release Drafter, semantic-release)
No formal incident response runbooks or on-call rotation
No documented RPO/RTO for disaster recovery

backend.auth_bypass: Direct token minting via create_access_token (bypasses bcrypt/passlib issue)
backend.coverage_tool: pytest-cov configured but no coverage thresholds enforced in CI

e2e.architecture: Boots real backend (uvicorn) + static web server
e2e.reporting: HTML report uploaded on failure (7-day retention)

mobile.coverage: Smoke tests only - renders without crashing

contract_testing.details: No Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, or consumer-driven contract testing
contract_testing.impact: Breaking API changes not caught until e2e or production

chaos_engineering.details: No Litmus, Chaos Mesh, Gremlin, or similar

load_testing.details: No k6, Locust, JMeter, or artillery scripts

mutation_testing.impact: Test suite effectiveness unknown - tests may pass but not catch bugs
